title: Encoder first component matches the recursive step
statement: Fix a DNF formula $f$ on $n$ variables, two restrictions $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$, a fuel budget, and a path $\mathrm{step} :: \mathrm{rest}$ consisting of a first variable–direction pair $\mathrm{step}$ followed by a list $\mathrm{rest}$ of further such pairs. Suppose $t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ is the first term of $f$ that is not killed by $\rho_0$, and that, listing the literals of $t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ each tagged with its position in the term and keeping only those whose variable is free under $\rho_0$, this filtered list is nonempty, of the form $\mathit{fl} :: \mathit{fls}$. Then the first component of the encoder run at fuel one greater on the whole path $\mathrm{step} :: \mathrm{rest}$ coincides with the first component of the encoder run at the smaller fuel started from the state obtained by processing the clause's free literals $\mathit{fl} :: \mathit{fls}$ against that same path from $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: a DNF formula f on n variables
a fuel budget and a path step :: rest of variable–direction pairs
t_clause is the first term of f not killed by ρ₀
the position-tagged literals of t_clause with variable free under ρ₀ form the nonempty list fl :: fls
caveat: The conclusion of the Lean statement is elided as `sorry` in the provided ground truth (`let pcl := sorry`), and the encoder function whose runs are being compared is not among the supplied definitions. The conclusion above is reconstructed from the `current` hint (equality of the first components of two encoder runs, one at fuel+1 on the full path and one at the lower fuel on the state produced by `processClauseLits` applied to fl :: fls), and cannot be verified against the formal statement; it may misstate the actual claim.
replaced:
When the encoder finds $t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ as the first clause not killed by $\rho_0$ and
its filtered free-variable literals form a nonempty list $\mathit{fl}::\mathit{fls}$, the
first component of the encoder run with fuel $\mathrm{fuel}+1$ on path $\mathit{step}::\mathit{rest}$
equals the first component of the recursive encoder run with fuel $\mathrm{fuel}$ on the
processed state $\mathrm{pcl} = \mathrm{processClauseLits}\,(\mathit{fl}::\mathit{fls})\,(\mathit{step}::\mathit{rest})\,\rho_0\,\sigma$.
